# Agent Bestiary — guide for AI agents

Agent Bestiary: 5,000 on-chain specimens on BNB Chain (chain id 56). Every piece prints the
owner's `.ai` agent handle, read from the Binance Agent ID registry at mint time. Art is SVG
generated by the contract; nothing is served from IPFS or a backend.

Human page: the site root. This file is everything an agent needs.

## Contracts

- NFT, ERC-721 "Agent Bestiary" (BEAST): `__NFT__`
- Market, ask + bid, 2% fee: `__MARKET__`
- Agent ID registry (mint gate, `balanceOf > 0`): `0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F`

## Rules

- 5,000 total.
- First piece per wallet is free while the free quota (1,000 pieces) lasts.
- After that, each piece costs `price()` — 0.0003 BNB (flat, no bonding curve).
- 5 pieces per wallet maximum, counted per minting wallet regardless of later transfers.
- Mint goes only to the calling wallet; contracts cannot mint for another address.
- No owner, no pause, no withdraw. Payment goes to the treasury inside the same transaction.
- Excess BNB is refunded in the same transaction.

## Read before minting (eth_call, free)

    hasAgentId(address) -> bool          quote(address) -> uint256 wei
    totalMinted() -> uint256             MAX_SUPPLY() -> uint256
    mintedBy(address) -> uint256         MAX_PER_WALLET() -> uint256
    freeMinted() -> uint256              FREE_QUOTA() -> uint256
    price() -> uint256                   revealed() -> bool
    traits(uint256) -> (uint8,uint8,uint8,uint8,uint8)
    tierOf(uint256) -> string            tokenURI(uint256) -> string (data:application/json;base64)

`quote(wallet)` returns 0 for a free piece, the price for a paid one, and `type(uint256).max`
when the wallet already holds the maximum. Treat the max value as "stop, do not mint".

## Minting

    mint() payable

Send exactly the value from `quote`. Nothing else is required — no allowlist, no signature.

Selectors: `mint()` = `0x1249c58b` · `quote(address)` = `0x0b39ed47` · `hasAgentId(address)` = `0x4eab3ef2`
`review()` = `0x701fd0f1` · `list(...)` = `0x19aeb490` · `buy(uint256)` = `0xd96a094a` · `acceptBid(uint256)` = `0x2b1fd58a`

Foundry example:

    cast call __NFT__ "quote(address)(uint256)" $WALLET --rpc-url https://bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org
    cast send __NFT__ "mint()" --value <quote> --rpc-url https://bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org

## Verify after minting

- receipt status must be 1.
- decode the `Minted(address indexed minter, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 paid, string handle)` event.
- `ownerOf(tokenId)` must equal the minting wallet.

## Market

    list(uint256 tokenId, uint256 price, uint256 durationDays)   // approve(market, tokenId) first
    cancelListing(uint256 tokenId)
    buy(uint256 tokenId) payable                                 // msg.value == price exactly
    bid(uint256 tokenId) payable                                 // >= 0.0001 BNB, held in escrow
    cancelBid(uint256 tokenId)
    acceptBid(uint256 tokenId)                                   // owner sells into standing bid

Views: `listingsPage(offset,limit)`, `bidsPage(offset,limit)`, `listedCount()`, `bidCount()`,
`floor()`, `listings(tokenId)`, `bids(tokenId)`.

Fee is 2% of the sale, taken from the seller's proceeds. Royalty is 2.5% (ERC-2981).

## Safety rules for agents

1. Never ask for or use a private key you were not handed by your own runtime.
2. Stop if `hasAgentId(wallet)` is false — the mint will revert with "No Agent ID".
3. Stop if `quote` returns the max uint256.
4. Simulate with `eth_call` before broadcasting.
5. Never approve more than one token id at a time, never approve for all unless the user asked.
6. Report the transaction hash and the paid amount; do not claim success before the receipt.

## Prompt template (copy into any agent)

    Mint 1 Agent Bestiary from this agent wallet (BNB Chain, chain id 56).
    NFT: __NFT__ · registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
    1. require registry.balanceOf(wallet) > 0, else stop and report "no Agent ID".
    2. read quote(wallet): 0 = free, 300000000000000 = paid, max = limit reached.
    3. eth_call mint() with value = quote; stop on revert.
    4. send mint() with value = quote exactly.
    5. wait for receipt status 1, decode Minted for tokenId.
    6. report tokenId, tx hash, BNB spent, final balance.
    Never exceed 5 pieces per wallet. Never ask for the private key.
